detailed_descriptions.en: The speed limit is infinity. The faster you move, the harder you hit. Grapple, slide, wall-run, and rail-grind to build momentum. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with wild movement tech and perfectly timed parries. Rip through robots in style to rack up views as your rampage goes viral worldwide in a fully-voiced story campaign. Craft overpowered weapon combos. Turn shotguns into flamethrowers. Turn bananas into nukes. Dual-wield 10 distinct weapons with dozens of augments and attachments to create endless game-breaking synergies. Show no mercy on rogue robots and evil billionaires. Battle legends like Johnny Jetpack. Clash with quirky villains from giant robot crabs to narcissistic nepo babies. Rack up kills to unleash time-bending powers and shatter clusters of foes in a single moment. Grow stronger and face new challenges with every death. Save your sister. Save Earth. Hunt down the architects of endless brutality in a blood-curdling odyssey through underwater prisons, cyberpunk cityscapes, and into the great beyond. Turn the tables on the evil CEO who made you into a killing machine.
